title: Accounting Statement: Required Amount of a Reinstated Security Deposit
content:
**Security Deposits — required amount of a deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis.**

## Calculation

1. **Amount before rounding.** The reinstated amount is the reinstatement multiple times the reinstatement basis bill when the account has at least the tier's minimum history, in billing periods, in the last twelve months; otherwise it is the higher of the tier's new-service flat estimate and the tier's estimate per kVA multiplied by the transformer kVA of the service account.
2. **Bills and billing periods.** A billing period's bill is the sum of that period's usage lines, and the number of billing periods is the number of facility charge lines.
3. **Reinstatement basis bill.** The basis bill is the average bill of the twelve billing periods immediately before today: the usage lines billed in the twelve months before today, added together and divided by the number of facility charge lines billed in those months.
4. **Reinstatement multiple.** The reinstatement multiple is the tier's deposit multiple.
5. **Rounding, floor and ceiling.** The result is rounded up to the next multiple of the tier's rounding increment (an amount already a whole multiple stays as it is), then raised to the tier's minimum deposit when lower, then limited to the tier's maximum deposit.
6. **No netting.** A reinstated deposit is the only deposit its account carries, because the waiver it replaces stood in place of that account's deposit, and it never exceeds the tier's maximum deposit.

The tier's deposit multiple, minimum history, flat estimate, estimate per kVA, rounding increment, minimum deposit and maximum deposit are those of the reinstated deposit's tier in the Security Deposits amount schedule. The bills, facility charge lines and transformer kVA are read from the service account the reinstated deposit secures.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Assume, for illustration, tier figures of a deposit multiple of 2.0, a minimum history of 6, a flat estimate of $200.00, an estimate per kVA of $0.00, a rounding increment of $5.00, a minimum deposit of $100.00 and a maximum deposit of $600.00.

| Case | Usage lines in the last twelve months | Facility charge lines | Basis bill | Amount before rounding | Required amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | $1530.60 | 12 | $127.55 | $255.10 | $260.00 |
| B | $4080.00 | 12 | $340.00 | $680.00 | limited to $600.00 |
| C | $510.00 | 4 | (history short) | $200.00 estimate | $200.00 |
| D | $540.00 | 12 | $45.00 | $90.00 | rounded to $90.00, raised to $100.00 |

In case C only four billing periods fall in the last twelve months, fewer than the minimum history of six, so the estimate is used.
